Compatibility pass 2026-08-29.2: mesa, vulkan loader/drivers, VM guest agents, firmware, laptop sensors and fonts, each name verified against the live pacman sync database.

bluetooth.label: Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Bluetooth stack and management tools. The island Bluetooth panel needs this.

printing.label: Printing
printing.description: CUPS print server, network printer discovery and a setup GUI.

development.label: Development tools
development.description: Containers, compilers, language runtimes and terminal Git/Docker UIs.

gaming.label: Gaming
gaming.description: A game streaming client and 32-bit OpenGL. The vendor 32-bit Vulkan driver comes from your hardware selection; Steam and launchers are installed per-title from the terminal.

scanning.label: Scanning
scanning.description: Document scanner support, including driverless network and USB scanners.

virtualisation-guest.label: Run as a VM guest
virtualisation-guest.description: Guest agents so Frost integrates with its host when it runs inside QEMU/KVM, SPICE, VMware or VirtualBox.

media-production.label: Media production
media-production.description: Screen recording, streaming and video editing.

tailscale.label: Tailscale
tailscale.description: Mesh VPN. The shell only shows the Tailscale control when this is on.

aur.label: AUR access
aur.description: An AUR helper and terminal package browsers. The hardened AUR build flow lands in Phase 6; this only installs the tools.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Boot, session, audio, network, security and recovery. No desktop applications.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.description: The full Frost desktop: everything in Minimal plus the recommended application set.

developer.label: Developer
developer.description: The Desktop profile plus the development toolchain and container stack.

this-machine.label: This machine
this-machine.description: Seeded on 2026-08-29 from the packages installed on the Vaio FE16 (Ryzen 5 5825U, all-AMD): the desktop set, the features actually in use, the AMD graphics stack, and the AUR apps carried over from Omarchy. A starting point — adjust and re-review before Gate 5.
